lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows along the posterior lateral flank, transitioning to a higher density of smaller, disordered clusters anteriorly towards the cephalic region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows on the posterior flank, creating a visible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge along the dorsal-lateral boundary, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high pixel intensity above and a distinct shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct transition from high-density, small diameter pixel clusters on the cephalic region to larger, regularly spaced blobs on the posterior flank.
